description: Finish posterly onboarding IN THIS conversation, for people who signed up through an AI app. Call whoami first: only when onboarding.completed is false, ask what to call them and their IANA timezone (for example Europe/London), then call this with name and timezone. It saves the same About you answers as the web onboarding and marks onboarding complete, so the dashboard and connect links open directly. Never call it, and never ask the onboarding questions, when onboarding.completed is already true. Next, offer create_connect_session for the network they want to post to first.

complete.description: Mark onboarding complete (default true). Pass false to save name or timezone only.

name.description: What to call the user (their display name in posterly). A name already taken gets a short suffix, which the result reports.

timezone.description: IANA timezone such as Europe/London or America/New_York. Free text such as a city name is rejected so you can ask again.

name: complete_onboarding
